# A14 input-to-motion — unification survey

Date: 2026-06-11 · Agent: A14 · Scope: keyboard/mouse input → motion intent (input side only; queue/anim = A4/A5, MoveTo internals = A3, position trio = A2).

## 1. Retail map

Retail funnels ALL player input through ONE owner chain: `CInputManager` → `ACCmdInterp::OnAction` → `ACCmdInterp::SetMotion` → `CommandInterpreter::MovePlayer` → (`CPhysicsObj::DoMotion`/`StopMotion` into raw state) or (Send*Event to server when non-autonomous).

| step | responsibility | cite |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ACCmdInterp::OnAction(InputEvent)` — switch on `m_InputAction`: 0x29/0x2A backstep/forward, 0x2B stop, 0x2C/0x2D sidestep L/R, 0x2E/0x2F turn R/L, 0x30 Ready, 0x31 jump (press → `vfptr[5].OnAction` = CommenceJump; release → FinishJump path), 0x32 autorun; default branch looks up `m_hashEmoteInputActionsToCommands` (Sitting, PrayState, …) and `SetMotion(cmd, 1)` | acclient.c:435951-436031 |
| 2 | `InitializeEmoteInputActionHash` — emote-state input actions are first-class keybindable inputs | acclient.c:436034 |
| 3 | `ACCmdInterp::SetMotion` — wraps `(motion, fOn)` in a `CmdStruct` and dispatches into the smartbox command interpreter | acclient.c:435936-435949 |
| 4 | `CommandInterpreter::MovePlayer` — the single movement-command funnel: per-axis CommandLists (Forward/Sidestep/Turn/Substate) bookkeeping, mouse-turning conversion (turn↔sidestep swap matrix), then `autonomy_level ? CPhysicsObj::DoMotion/StopMotion : MovePlayer_NonAutonomous`; DoMotion error codes (62/63/64/65/66/68) surface user-facing "too tired / can't crouch in combat" text | acclient.c:717800-718048 |
| 5 | `CommandInterpreter::MovePlayer_NonAutonomous` → `ACCmdInterp::SendDoMovementEvent`/`SendStopMovementEvent` (`CM_Movement::Event_DoMovementCommand`) when server controls movement | acclient.c:717669-717688, 435887-435897 |
| 6 | HoldKey semantics: `SetHoldRun` — effective run = `hold_run` XOR `UITogglesRun()` (the persisted ToggleRun PlayerModule option); autonomous → `CMotionInterp::set_hold_run`, else re-issues 0x85000001 RunForward | acclient.c:716978-717012, 435818-435830, 344492 |
| 7 | `SetHoldSidestep` + `ApplyHoldKeysToCommand` — hold-sidestep MODIFIER converts TurnRight 0x6500000D→SideStepRight 0x6500000F / TurnLeft 0x6500000E→SideStepLeft 0x65000010 (turn keys are primary; sidestep is a chord) | acclient.c:717014-717024, 716962-716975 |
| 8 | Autorun: `ToggleAutoRun` / `auto_run` branch of `ApplyCurrentMovement` (drives 0x45000005 at `autorun_speed`); `SetAutoRun` | acclient.c:717657, 717027-717064, 718254 |

Row 1 symptom caveat: the duplicate-dispatch half is benign today because both trackers compute identical axes and the Rust side edge-detects; the harm concentrates in the suppression/stomp interactions (orbit, charge-end) and in every future fix having to land twice.

## 4. Staged unification plan

Pattern: collapse JS input to ONE `InputController` (retail `ACCmdInterp` analog) that owns keystate, policy (typing-guard, blur, mode suppression), and the single `setMovementInput` boundary; then move synthetic movers off the input API.

- **Stage I1 — single JS InputController** · scope: new `scene3d/input.js` owning keystate + the only `setMovementInput` call; `index.html:8562/8633/8761/10823-10841` and `camera.js:1571-1610/1464-1521` become consumers (camera contributes a `movementPolicy()` = orbit-suppress/topDown mapping, index.html contributes typing-guard + enteredWorld gate). Jump keydown/keyup moves in unchanged. · flag: `?inputFunnel=on` (default-off, url-flags.md style; off = both legacy paths) · JS-live · tests: headless-now (node-side unit on sig dedupe + suppression matrix; grep-assert exactly one `setMovementInput(` call site when flag on) · rollback: flag off.
- **Stage I2 — synthetic movers off the input API** · scope: replace picking.js `chargeTick`/`turnToFaceThenAct` axis injection with a wasm intent (`PlayerDriveIntent::PursueEntity{guid,range}` / `TurnToHeading`) so MovementSystem arbitrates manual vs autonomous exactly like retail's CommandLists + UseTime; charge-end restores the held manual intent automatically (fixes div #2 stomp). Files: picking.js:230-420, lib.rs bridge (new SessionCommand), system.rs intent enum. · flag: `?wasmPursuit=on` · wasm-rebuild · tests: headless-now (system.rs unit: manual intent survives pursuit end; cf. existing tests.rs:1448 pattern); 1070-gated eye-test for pursuit feel · depends: A3's MoveToManager stage (do not duplicate its MoveTo math — this stage only re-homes the ENTRY point) · rollback: flag off.
- **Stage I3 — hold-key/options parity** · scope: persisted ToggleRun option (options-panel + keymap.js row) XORed with Shift per acclient.c:716978; autorun key + `auto_run` re-issue branch in MovementSystem (acclient.c:717027); optional hold-sidestep chord. Files: input.js, ui/keymap.js, system.rs (autorun intent). · flag: `?retailRunKeys=on` · autorun half wasm-rebuild, option half JS-live · tests: headless-now (intent-table unit) · rollback: flag off.
- **Stage I4 — jump-charge ownership + gates** · scope: move the charge clock wasm-side (extend existing `jumpChargeBegin`, lib.rs:25951 — JS keeps only UI bar reading a wasm getter), add `jump_charge_is_allowed` load/position gates + failure text events per acclient.c:343318/408195-408206; fold `?longJump` rooting into the same owner. · flag: `?jumpParity=on` · wasm-rebuild · tests: headless-now (gate unit: burden>limit → 73, crouch substate → 72); 1070-gated for charge feel · depends: Stage 1 eye-test PASS (interpreted-state position gate reads interp_state) · rollback: flag off.

Order: I1 → I2 → {I3, I4 in either order}. I1 is pure JS and unblocks everything.

## 5. Scores

- Leverage: subsumes/re-homes F7-3, F8-5, F6-4, F6-5 (picking synthetic-input point fixes, cited at picking.js:248-251, 381, 396) and G-7/F1-6 + F1-5 follow-ons (jump charge family, index.html:8479-8504). Future input fixes land once instead of 2-3 times.
- Regression-risk reduction: **H** (input is the top of the movement keystone; div #1/#2 are exactly the "fix regresses elsewhere" shape).
- Implementation risk: I1 **L-M** (JS-only, flag-gated), I2 **M** (new wasm intent, touches system.rs arbitration), I3 **L**, I4 **M**.
- 1070-dependency: I1 **N** (headless-verifiable), I2/I4 **Y** for feel eye-tests (logic tests headless).
- Depends-on: A3 (MoveToManager spec — I2 entry point must target its shape), A2 seam (turn-to-face is TurnTo, position trio untouched), A13 (JumpPack/MoveToStatePack codec — I4 emits through whatever single send boundary A13 proposes), Stage 1 eye-test PASS gates I4.
- Conflict surfaces for A16: `index.html` input block, `camera.js`, `picking.js`, `lib.rs` bridge, `system.rs` — overlaps A2/A3 (system.rs) and A13 (lib.rs send boundary); serialize with those.
